note: A slow cold projectile that pierces everything in its path.

def.name: Glacier Dart
def.description: A slow shard of ice that pierces everything in its path.

note: A volley of three short-lived arrows, half lightning; each shot also releases one lightning burst in a cone in front of the shooter that hits every enemy in it.

def.name: Storm Quill
def.description: Looses arrows crackling with lightning that burst in a cone.

note: Icicles burst from the ground in a line of five bursts (modelled as a zone along the cast line).

def.name: Rime Spires
def.description: Icicles burst from the ground in a rolling line.

note: A heavy cold blow with a mace, sceptre or staff: more damage and cold against the chilled, every third strike freezes as though it dealt much more, and a frozen enemy on under a third of its life shatters.

def.name: Rime Mallet
def.description: A heavy blow that chills; every third one freezes hard, and a frozen enemy that is nearly dead shatters.

note: A slam that makes a shockwave in front of the character, with more damage close in.

def.name: Quake Blow
def.description: Slams the ground and sends out a wave; enemies close in are hit harder and stun more easily.

note: A slam in three stages that is half cold (the stages are averaged).

def.name: Frost Sunder
def.description: A heavy slam that sends frost out in three waves.

note: A ring of frost that expands from the caster (or from up to two of the character’s Glacier Darts, with 20% less area) and deals more to chilled enemies.

def.name: Frost Ring
def.description: A ring of frost that spreads from you, or from your Glacier Darts, hitting chilled enemies harder.

note: A cold-converted arrow that chills more strongly than usual (the cone behind the target is dropped).

def.name: Frost Quill
def.description: An arrow that chills its target to the bone.

note: A torrent of fire that widens and strengthens the longer it is held; letting go sends a final wave that always ignites, for 500% more ignite damage.

def.name: Blaze Stream
def.description: A torrent of fire from your hand that widens and strengthens the longer you hold it; letting go sends a final wave.

note: A fire strike that puts a charge on the enemy (up to six, renewed by hits, lasting under a second); at six, when they run out or when it dies, the charges burst in an area for 66% of the hit each, and an enemy that dies carrying them bursts as fire for 6% of its life.

def.name: Cinder Blow
def.description: A fiery strike that primes the enemy to burst.

note: Two sweeping slashes; in Blood Stance they bleed (chance and more bleed damage), in Sand Stance the arc is wider and they do not.

def.name: Twin Slash
def.description: Two sweeping slashes; bleeding in Blood Stance, a wider sweep in Sand Stance.

note: A thrust that throws a main blade that impales, with four lesser shards.

def.name: Hurled Steel
def.description: A thrust that hurls a main blade that impales, with shards flying beside it.

note: A cold crystal that stands for two seconds: its pulses leave enemies near it exposed to cold (25% less resistance) and regenerating 75% less for five seconds; then it bursts, and the burst is the only hit. It waits two and a half seconds.

def.name: Rime Core
def.description: A crystal of cold that exposes the enemies near it to frost and stops their regeneration, then bursts.
